scope: Proposition 9.2 (Counts for the tested core tuples) of the manuscript “An L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform” (preprints/An-L3-bound-for-the-trilinear-Hilbert-transform-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 086 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 24b584066ae76b2f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 87. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
